findings.title: Present incapacity and later response
findings.claim: The focus's present inability to find a way is set beside a later scene in which the one who first originated the audience summons them and they respond; practical incapacity and effective response occupy different moments.

The compliance coloration of the focus verb can suggest receptivity, while the later response shows effective movement without proving willing obedience.
